image_defaults.prompt_suffix: Visual style: calm, precise, premium, quiet confidence. A matte warm paper ground (#F7F5F0) with fine paper-fibre grain, one soft natural light source and a soft shadow, no gloss. Palette: warm paper, ink (#0C2027), slate, and at most ONE small gold (#F5C13A) accent, with at most a touch of muted teal. Large areas of deliberate empty negative space so text can be placed on top later. Flat, restrained, editorial. Avoid: neon, lens flare, glossy 3D blobs, cyber grids, circuit boards, rockets, light bulbs, handshakes, stock-photo people, faces, hands, fake UI, charts, and any text, letters, numbers, logos or watermarks in the image.

assets.prompt: A brass-rimmed magnifying glass resting on a blank sheet of warm paper, soft natural shadow, light from the upper left. Everything sits in the lower half of the frame; the upper 45% is empty ground. Shot straight from above. No printed or written text anywhere.

slides.title: Readable contrast.
slides.lead: Dark on light, or the reverse. Avoid grey on grey.

slides.title: Text you can read.
slides.lead: Body text large enough to read on a phone without zooming.

slides.title: Alt text on images.
slides.lead: A short description so screen readers can say what the image shows.

slides.title: Big, clear buttons.
slides.lead: Easy to tap, with words that say what happens next.

caption:
Four quick accessibility wins.

Readable contrast, text you can read on a phone, alt text on images, and big clear buttons.
